ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with approximately 35% high-intensity pixels (white) and 65% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields localized on the lateral lobes (approximately 40% of horizontal span each). Low-intensity black contiguous region dominates the central-axial zone and forms a thick continuous band (10-15% height) along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 14 degrees; vertical depth occupies roughly 18% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2 to 12 pixels; topographical ruggedness increases significantly at the distal tips with several deep jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a symmetrical concave sweep from the median notch to the outer tips; leading edges show a broad convex arc trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast textured clusters localized at the distal tips (barnacle colonization); isolated low-intensity circular spots (5-10 pixel diameter) distributed within the lateral white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear streaks; prominent vertical disruption on the left medial lobe; several thin diagonal disruptions on the right lateral lobe field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural erosion and tissue irregularity at both distal tips associated with heavy barnacle encrustations.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of distinct, isolated dark circular focal spots on the high-intensity background of both lateral lobes.
